CustomField.description: SCC-3380: Confirmation that closing this Incident should also close Trouble Ticket cases linked in Case Related Issue. Incident_After_Update only bulk-closes related cases when this box is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: SCC-3380: Check this box when setting Status to Closed if the related Trouble Tickets should be closed as well. Leave unchecked to close only this Incident.
CustomField.label: Close Related Trouble Tickets
